chapterInfo.content:
40
Wɔtu Tenabea no hyɛ AWURADE nsa
1 # Eks 25.1-31 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no na si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no tenabea no. 3Na fa adanseɛ adaka no si mu, na fa ntwamutam no kata adaka no ani. 4Na fa ɛpono no kɔ mu, na siesie deɛ wɔde sisi soɔ no; na fa kaneadua no kɔ mu, na fa ne nkanea no sisi so. 5Na fa sika aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia no kɔsi adanseɛ adaka no anim; na fa tenabea no ano nkataano no sɛne hɔ. 6Na fa ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano. 7Na fa kuduo no si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na fa nsuo gu mu. 8Na sisi adihɔ no hyia, na fa adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no sɛne hɔ. 9Na fa sra ngo no sra tenabea no ne emu adeɛ nyinaa, na yɛ ɛno ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa kronkron na ɛnyɛ akronkronneɛ. 10Na sra ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ngo, na yɛ afɔrebukyia no kronkron, na afɔrebukyia no nyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. 11Na sra kuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ no ngo, na yɛ no kronkron. 12Na fa Aaron ne ne mma no bra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na fa nsuo dware wɔn.
13Na fa ntade kronkron no hyɛ Aaron, na sra no ngo yɛ no kronkron, na ɔnni me sɔfoɔ. 14Na fa ne mma nso bra, na hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, 15na sra wɔn ngo, sɛdeɛ wosraa wɔn agya no, na wɔnni me asɔfoɔ, na wɔn sra no nyɛ wɔn daa asɔfodie, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. 16Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa ara na ɔyɛeɛ.
17Na ɛbaa sɛ afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no, wɔsii tenabea no. 18Na Mose sii tenabea no, na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne nnyinasoɔ na ɔgyinagyinaa ne ntaaboɔ no, na ɔde ne mmeamu no beabeaa mu, na ɔgyinagyinaa ne nsisimu adum. 19Na ɔyeree ntomadan no kataa tenabea no so, na ɔde ntomadan no nkatasoɔ no kataa so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 20Na ɔfaa Adanseɛ no de hyɛɛ adaka no mu, na ɔde mpoma wurawuraa adaka no ho, na ɔde mpata adwa no sii adaka no so; 21na ɔde adaka no kɔɔ tenabea no mu, na ɔsii ntwamutam no, na ɔde kataa adanseɛ adaka no ano, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 22Na ɔde ɛpono no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam wɔ ntwamutam no akyi; 23na ɔsiesiee ɛso paanoo AWURADE anim sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 24Na ɔde kaneadua no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ɛpono no ntentensoɔ wɔ tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ anafoɔ fam; 25na ɔde nkanea no sisii so AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 26Na ɔde sika afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ntwamutam no anim; 27na ɔhyee so aduhwam, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no. 28Na ɔde nkataano no sɛnee tenabea no ano. 29Na ɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 30Na ɔde kuduo no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na ɔde nsuo guu mu sɛ wɔmfa nhohoro wɔn ho. 31Na Mose ne Aaron ne ne mma no de hohoroo wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho; 32sɛ wɔkɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛbɛn afɔrebukyia no ho a, wɔhohoroo wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 33Na ɔsii adihɔ no de twaa tenabea no ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae, na ɔde adihɔ no aboboano ntwamutam no sɛnee hɔ. Na Mose wiee adwuma no.
Mununkum bɛkata Tenabea no so
(Numeri 9.15-23)
34 # Eks 13.21; Num 9.15-23; 1 Ah 8.10-11; Yes 4.5; Hes 43.5 Ɛnna mununkum no bɛkataa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no soɔ, na AWURADE animuonyam bɛhyɛɛ tenabea no ma. 35Na Mose antumi anhyɛne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na mununkum no te so, na AWURADE animuonyam ahyɛ tenabea no ma. 36#Num 10.34-36 Na Israelfoɔ akwantuo no nyinaa mu, sɛ mununkum no ma ne ho so firi tenabea no so a, na wɔkɔ wɔn anim; 37na sɛ mununkum no amma ne ho so a, ɛnneɛ wɔntu ara kɔsi da a ɛma ne ho soɔ. 38Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn akwantuo no nyinaa mu, na AWURADE mununkum no wɔ tenabea no so awia, na ogya wɔ mu anadwo, Israel fie no nyinaa anim.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no na si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no tenabea no. Na fa adanseɛ adaka no si mu, na fa ntwamutam no kata adaka no ani. Na fa ɛpono no kɔ mu, na siesie deɛ wɔde sisi soɔ no; na fa kaneadua no kɔ mu, na fa ne nkanea no sisi so. Na fa sika aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia no kɔsi adanseɛ adaka no anim; na fa tenabea no ano nkataano no sɛne hɔ. Na fa ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano. Na fa kuduo no si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na fa nsuo gu mu. Na sisi adihɔ no hyia, na fa adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no sɛne hɔ. Na fa sra ngo no sra tenabea no ne emu adeɛ nyinaa, na yɛ ɛno ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa kronkron na ɛnyɛ akronkronneɛ. Na sra ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ngo, na yɛ afɔrebukyia no kronkron, na afɔrebukyia no nyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. Na sra kuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ no ngo, na yɛ no kronkron. Na fa Aaron ne ne mma no bra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na fa nsuo dware wɔn.
Na fa ntade kronkron no hyɛ Aaron, na sra no ngo yɛ no kronkron, na ɔnni me sɔfoɔ. Na fa ne mma nso bra, na hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, na sra wɔn ngo, sɛdeɛ wosraa wɔn agya no, na wɔnni me asɔfoɔ, na wɔn sra no nyɛ wɔn daa asɔfodie, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa ara na ɔyɛeɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no, wɔsii tenabea no. Na Mose sii tenabea no, na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne nnyinasoɔ na ɔgyinagyinaa ne ntaaboɔ no, na ɔde ne mmeamu no beabeaa mu, na ɔgyinagyinaa ne nsisimu adum. Na ɔyeree ntomadan no kataa tenabea no so, na ɔde ntomadan no nkatasoɔ no kataa so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Na ɔfaa Adanseɛ no de hyɛɛ adaka no mu, na ɔde mpoma wurawuraa adaka no ho, na ɔde mpata adwa no sii adaka no so; na ɔde adaka no kɔɔ tenabea no mu, na ɔsii ntwamutam no, na ɔde kataa adanseɛ adaka no ano, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Na ɔde ɛpono no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam wɔ ntwamutam no akyi; na ɔsiesiee ɛso paanoo AWURADE anim sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Na ɔde kaneadua no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ɛpono no ntentensoɔ wɔ tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ anafoɔ fam; na ɔde nkanea no sisii so AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Na ɔde sika afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ntwamutam no anim; na ɔhyee so aduhwam, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no. Na ɔde nkataano no sɛnee tenabea no ano. Na ɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Na ɔde kuduo no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na ɔde nsuo guu mu sɛ wɔmfa nhohoro wɔn ho. Na Mose ne Aaron ne ne mma no de hohoroo wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho; sɛ wɔkɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛbɛn afɔrebukyia no ho a, wɔhohoroo wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Na ɔsii adihɔ no de twaa tenabea no ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae, na ɔde adihɔ no aboboano ntwamutam no sɛnee hɔ. Na Mose wiee adwuma no.


Ɛnna mununkum no bɛkataa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no soɔ, na AWURADE animuonyam bɛhyɛɛ tenabea no ma. Na Mose antumi anhyɛne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na mununkum no te so, na AWURADE animuonyam ahyɛ tenabea no ma. Na Israelfoɔ akwantuo no nyinaa mu, sɛ mununkum no ma ne ho so firi tenabea no so a, na wɔkɔ wɔn anim; na sɛ mununkum no amma ne ho so a, ɛnneɛ wɔntu ara kɔsi da a ɛma ne ho soɔ. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn akwantuo no nyinaa mu, na AWURADE mununkum no wɔ tenabea no so awia, na ogya wɔ mu anadwo, Israel fie no nyinaa anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
